_comment: Copy this file to your subject's run directory as config.json and fill in the real values. The PhantomBuster API key is NOT here; it comes from the PHANTOMBUSTER_API_KEY environment variable (see scripts/.env.example). This file holds per-subject identity: which phantoms to run, how to name their outputs, and optional labels and notification settings.
_comment_active_master_name: Name for the active-only master CSV written each run (unfollowers excluded, lost_on column dropped). {date} is replaced with the run date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 'active master - {date}' when absent.
_comment_notification: Controls which elements appear in the one-line push notification. Remove this block to use the default (active_total, new_total, new_in_target, in_target_active_total). Available tokens: active_total, new_total, new_in_target, in_target_active_total, per_segment_active, per_segment_new, net, lost. Unknown tokens are silently skipped. See QUICKSTART.md for details.
